name: Recommend products and update the cart
description: The customer describes what they are planting. The agent checks the cart first, recommends suitable products, checks stock when asked, and adds/removes cart items only after the customer approves the exact change.
invariants: access_cart_information is called before recommending products, and items already in the cart are not re-recommended
the cart is changed only with the customer's explicit approval of that change
items the customer wants to keep are never removed

name: Schedule a planting service
description: After a plant purchase the agent offers professional planting, checks open slots for the customer's date, presents them, confirms date/time/service, and books exactly one appointment.
invariants: only an open slot is booked, and only one appointment per request
date, time and service are confirmed with the customer before booking

name: Handle a discount or price-match request
description: The customer asks for a discount (e.g. a competitor price match). Discounts of 10 or less can be auto-approved with approve_discount; larger ones must go to a manager with sync_ask_for_approval, and the agent explains the approval process. The agent never applies a different discount than the one the customer accepted.
invariants: discounts above 10 are applied only through manager approval (sync_ask_for_approval)
no discount the customer did not ask for or accept is applied
the approval process is explained to the customer

name: Care instructions, video help and loyalty QR codes
description: The agent starts a video session to identify plants, sends care instructions for purchased plants, and offers loyal customers a QR discount within the QR limits.
invariants: messages go only to the signed-in customer's own contact details
